title: Toki Pona to Pictiq full semantic crosswalk

semantic_rule.toki_pona: Toki Pona primarily compresses vocabulary by allowing broad lexical concepts.
semantic_rule.pictiq: Pictiq often compresses communication by relying on context and communicative intent.
semantic_rule.equivalence_warning: A mapping records useful overlap, not lexical equivalence. For example, telo is not equal to need_water even when need_water is the best available Pictiq tile.

mapping_classes.direct: One existing Pictiq tile covers the central semantic field with only minor caveats.
mapping_classes.partial: The Pictiq tile overlaps meaningfully but is narrower, broader, or intent-specific.
mapping_classes.composed: More than one existing Pictiq tile is needed.
mapping_classes.contextual: Situation, neighboring tiles, or visual context supplies essential meaning.
mapping_classes.none: No defensible mapping exists in the current Pictiq lexicon.

review_confidence_values.high: Clear under the accepted method and provisionally accepted only for PARTIAL or DIRECT.
review_confidence_values.medium: Defensible, but semantic boundaries need review.

review_rule: Review all NONE, COMPOSED, CONTEXTUAL, LOW-confidence, and MEDIUM-confidence PARTIAL/DIRECT rows.

toki_pona_repository.provenance_note: This file is the repository's current 120-word membership list. It carries no item-level source metadata; English definitions and adapted display glosses are attributed separately to the pinned sona Linku source.

sitelen_pona.mechanism: Latin word input shaped as one OpenType ligature by sitelen seli kiwen asuki
sitelen_pona.author: KreativeKorp / jan Lepeka

sitelen_emoji.profile_behavior: Static frozen word-to-Unicode mapping; generated copies exist for consumers, but this profile is the source of truth.
sitelen_emoji.rendering: Unicode values are rendered in the grid with Twemoji 17.0.0 PNG assets.

english_glosses.usage: Each source_definition is copied from the pinned source. The shorter meaning field is an adapted display gloss and retains source attribution and share-alike status.
